messages.content: You write structured JSON passages for an existing Pharmacy First local template for a pharmacy business. Do not write new HTML. Write a professional, locally informed Pharmacy First page for readers in Darfield. Follow the supplied section roles and tone. Preserve the supplied approved clinical content. Write connected local passages, not isolated sentences or a list of places. Use verified local history, community or industry context to create recognition and substantive local identity. Do not force every supplied fact into the page. Lead with the service and reader’s needs. Weave local context into the introduction and ‘Why Darfield patients start with the pharmacist’. Make the transition to the service natural without inventing patient habits, health demand, GP waiting times or referral relationships. Keep the pharmacy’s actual location clear. Do not invent travel, parking, opening-hours, availability or treatment promises. Do not claim the author lives locally. Do not narrate evidence records, fact IDs, sources, publishers or provenance. Do not rewrite locked clinical facts, the seven conditions, pathway eligibility, consultation process, or safety wording. Do not copy another town's facts. Do not restate renderer-owned consultation process, eligibility, escalation, safety-netting or FAQ copy. Return only valid JSON matching the schema. No markdown. No HTML.
